name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-postgres
description: PostgreSQL schema exploration, read-only SQL & governed changes for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_URL
environmentVariables.description: libpq connection string, e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db (or use PGHOST/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD/PGDATABASE).

environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_SCHEMA_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated schemas the agent may touch (empty = all).
